stock_source.title: Stock reservation
stock_source.description: checkout: tracked stock of the items Checkout knows is decremented in your database inside the placement transaction; catalog: the Catalog product reserves it (POST /v1/stock-reservations); none: no stock check.

expiry_owner.title: Who cancels expired unpaid orders
expiry_owner.description: checkout: this product cancels them (order.cancelled@1, reason expired) and gives stock back; orders: the Order Manager does.

orders_per_hour.title: Orders per shopper per hour
orders_per_hour.description: Placements per shopper (identity, else network address) per hour from browser keys.

require_expected_total.title: Require the total the shopper saw
require_expected_total.description: Placement answers 409 total_changed (with the new totals) when the server's total differs from expectedTotal.

customer_cancellable.title: Shoppers may cancel an unconfirmed order
